product_one_liner.value: voize is an AI voice-documentation app for caregivers in long-term care and skilled nursing facilities that converts spoken notes into structured EHR entries.
product_one_liner.notes: The product FAQ describes the intended care settings and explains that caregivers' speech is converted into structured EHR entries: https://www.voize.ai/us.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page explains licensing by the number of people receiving care rather than individual user accounts. Public numeric prices are not required by the question: https://www.voize.de/preise.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both Caritas Stuttgart and AGAPLESION appear in the company's customer logo area on its pricing page: https://www.voize.de/preise. | named_customers.0: Caritas Stuttgart appears in the customer logo area: https://www.voize.de/preise. | named_customers.1: AGAPLESION appears in the customer logo area: https://www.voize.de/preise.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator reports a team size of 140, placing voize in the 101–200 band. This is a reported count rather than a real-time payroll total: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/voize.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's press page explicitly identifies its headquarters as Berlin, corroborated by its Y Combinator location. A company database instead lists Potsdam, so the explicit company headquarters statement is preferred. Sources: https://www.voize.de/presse and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/voize. | hq_country: Y Combinator identifies voize's location as Berlin, Germany: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/voize.

founded_year.notes: The company's press page explicitly states that voize was founded in 2020: https://www.voize.de/presse.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering team's blog lists at least two qualifying technical posts: Reuben Morais on Prometheus/OpenTelemetry monitoring and Erik Ziegler on cross-platform PyTorch inference. Source: https://tech.voize.de/.

public_docs.notes: The public help center lists a hospital documentation collection containing 23 articles, satisfying the multi-article requirement: https://help.voize.de/de/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior ML Engineer – NLP posting includes an application link and qualifies under the requested role titles: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/voize/f4939c9a-041c-4383-80e0-1072c8f48241.

model_provider.notes: The company's ML engineering posting explicitly says, 'We use Claude through our inference service,' alongside open and on-device models: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/voize/f4939c9a-041c-4383-80e0-1072c8f48241.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center lists HIPAA and GDPR. Its FAQ confirms HIPAA compliance and explicitly says voize is not yet ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certified, so those are excluded. These are public compliance claims, not an assertion that GDPR or HIPAA constitutes an independently issued certification. Sources: https://trust.voize.ai/ and https://trust.voize.ai/faq. | compliance_certs.0: The trust FAQ explicitly states that voize is HIPAA compliant: https://trust.voize.ai/faq. | compliance_certs.1: GDPR is explicitly listed in the trust center's compliance section: https://trust.voize.ai/.

raised_18mo.notes: The $50 million Series A announcement is dated November 17, 2025, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026: https://www.balderton.com/news/voize-raises-50-million-to-power-the-ai-companion-transforming-nursing-care.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Sales Development Representative posting includes an application link: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/voize/b8a80d0e-a245-4d90-89ba-317190aff23c.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 22, 2026 announcement introduces voice-based AI documentation integrated into Dedalus ORBIS, a substantive clinical workflow integration within May 9–November 9, 2026: https://www.voize.ai/de/presse/dedalus-voize-integration-orbis.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luis Semprun's profile records a September 2026 start as VP Engineering at voize, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. This is profile evidence rather than a company appointment announcement: https://linkedin.com/in/semprunl.
